title: Claim: threat actors say they hold INTT user data; VE Sin Filtro says leaks are unverified
date_note: VE Sin Filtro's alert was circulated on 23 November per the article; the article is dated 25 November.
summary: VE Sin Filtro alerted that two threat actors claimed to have obtained databases with personal data and passwords of INTT users and officials; one claim covers the past month. Conexión Segura y Libre notified INTT and Suscerte. Another actor claimed the full database on 26 October. VE Sin Filtro said neither leak has been verified; the article reports no INTT response.
plain: A digital-rights group says hackers claim to have INTT user and official data. The group says none of it has been verified, and no INTT response is reported.
exec: Unverified claims of a leak of INTT user and official data, per VE Sin Filtro; no INTT response is reported.

sources.name: Venezuela El Diario: Alertaron sobre posible filtración de datos de más de 4 millones de usuarios del INTT

validation.note: El Diario only, relaying VE Sin Filtro; INTT statement not read.

review.note: stronger than the source: one of the two claims covers the past month; Conexión Segura y Libre notified INTT/Suscerte; summary reworded
